# Touying

> Touying is a Typst package for presentation slides, an alternative to LaTeX Beamer. Headings create slides, a
> theme is applied with a show rule, `#pause` reveals content step by step, and `touying-scene` adds manim-style
> animated scenes (equations, graphs, morphs, 3D) that play in a self-contained HTML export.

Read [llms-full.txt](llms-full.txt) before writing a deck. It covers the complete API with verified examples, rules
that prevent common errors, an error-message table and a checklist.

Essentials:

- `#import "@preview/touying:0.8.1": *`, then `#import themes.metropolis: *` and
  `#show: metropolis-theme.with(aspect-ratio: "16-9", config-info(title: [..], author: [..]))`.
- `= Section`, `== Slide title`; `#title-slide()`; `#focus-slide[..]`; `#speaker-note[..]`.
- `#pause`, `#meanwhile`, `#uncover("2-")[..]`, `#only(2)[..]`, `#alternatives[..][..]`; use
  `slide(repeat: n, self => ..)` where markers cannot reach.
- Scenes are in the development checkout (branch `feature/animations`), so import it by path:
  `#import "/lib.typ": *` and `#let sc = touying-scene`.
  - Then: `#sc.scene(width:, height:, objects: (..), timeline: (..))`.
  - Times are seconds; coordinates are scene units, with y up.
- PDF: `typst compile slides.typ`. Animated HTML: `touying compile slides.typ` (touying-exporter, in
  `dependencies/touying-exporter`).

## Reference

- [llms-full.txt](llms-full.txt): the complete agent reference (slides, themes, animations, configuration, scenes,
  graphs, morphing, emphasis, 3D, HTML export, errors).
